$comment: F-1b PROPOSED grants for the three Finance APPROVAL capabilities (DECISIONS #F-1b; Owner register docs/governance/owner-commercial-spec-rulings-2026-10-20.md section 2: 'reconciled with existing finance policies, including R3 / #193 (Parts Manager revoked) and the A6 summary keys, before any grant'). A PROPOSAL, not an activation: the controller verifies it against nonprod (read-only) before writing migration 1764702000000, and may delete section 7 of the migration to register the capabilities with NO grants. Nothing here is Firebase parity (Firebase had no approval step). Derived from the committed role-capability baseline (functions/src/adminPolicy/seed/roleCapabilityAuthorityBaseline.json); the nonprod database was NOT read (no credential in this lane).

rules: Approvers are a SUBSET of the existing record holders: the Finance roles that already hold the record keys. No role that cannot request a Finance correction can approve one.

partsManager is NOT granted (R3 / DECISIONS #193 revoked its Finance execution; the committed baseline still lists the migration grants finance.adjustment.record and finance.invoice.issue, which nonprod revoked by Administration decision). Nothing here restores it, and the migration honours any ADMIN_REVOKED decision.

admin is NOT granted: the settlement keys (DECISIONS #206, migration 1764510000000) went to exactly owner, generalManager, controller, accountingManager, financeManager -- 'administering EOS confers no Finance transaction authority'. The approval keys are BUSINESS_ACTION, so Protected Administrator standing does not imply them; a Finance company assignment is also required at every call.

No A6 summary-key role (fieldManager, partsAssociate, partsManager, purchasingManager, salesManager, salesperson, shopAssociate, shopManager) is granted: A6 is read-only and confers no receivable write authority.

Approval by Role is never sufficient: the approving Employee must differ from the requesting Employee (and Principal), and hold a Finance company assignment at the invoice's company with FULL inner reach.
A holder of an approval key who also holds the record key can request but never approve their own request: the rule is by Employee, enforced in the command and by CHECK in the database.
unclear: The live nonprod holders were not read in this lane. The controller confirms (read-only) that the five proposed Roles exist, hold the record keys, carry no ADMIN_REVOKED decision on the new keys, and that no Role gains a pair other than these 15.
Whether generalManager should approve VOID is a policy choice carried from the settlement-key precedent (it holds every Finance execution key); the Owner may narrow it.

baselineRowsIfGranted.$comment: If section 7 of the migration is kept, roleCapabilityAuthorityBaseline.json gains exactly these rows (Owner ruling E: the baseline carries the same pairs), source MIGRATION_BACKED, evidence migration:1764702000000, and totalGrants / countsBySource.MIGRATION_BACKED each rise by 15.
